s01.text: Have you ever wondered why some soils struggle to grow healthy plants, even when they receive enough water and fertilizer?

s02.text: One substance that can help improve soil conditions is humic acid.

s03.text: Humic acid is an organic substance formed through the long-term decomposition of plant and animal materials in the soil.

s04.text: It plays an important role in improving soil structure, helping the soil retain moisture, and making certain nutrients more available to plants.

s05.text: It can also support root development and increase beneficial biological activity in the soil.

s06.text: Humic acid is commonly available in three forms: liquid, powder, and granules.

s07.text: Each form has its own application method, so the right amount depends on the product concentration, plant type, and soil conditions.

s08.text: But remember, humic acid is not a replacement for NPK fertilizers.

s09.text: It works alongside them to create better conditions for plant growth.

s10.text: So, healthy plants start with healthy soil!
